The sheet has a thickness of 50 micrometers, a porosity of 15%, a tensile strength of 3 MPa, and an ionic conductivity of 2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The dry sheet is useful as a separator layer for roll-to-roll production, with improved sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. When fired at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. Specific examples are argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The material is useful as a ceramic ion conductor layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a method for sintering an aluminum-doped Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet to a relative density of 92% or more while suppressing lithium volatilization. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The dopant aluminum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.05 to 0.4, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The sintered body has a relative density of 95%, an average grain size of 5 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed between the positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer, wherein the solid electrolyte layer is formed by the method of claim 1.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ion-conductive solid that does not require long mechanical milling. The suspension has a solid concentration of 4 wt% to 16 wt% and is reacted at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The solvent is tetrahydrofuran, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. Specific examples are argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. The Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 5 mS/cm. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the sinterability of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 120 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 1 wt% to 32 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2 mS/cm or more.

title: Zirconium-substituted perovskite-type LLTO ceramic ion conductor stable above 5 V and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a ceramic ion conductor whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A capacity retention of 92% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. A solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the zirconium substitution and the surface region. The positive electrode active material is a 5 V spinel, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ceramic ion conductor. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The oxide ceramic ion conductor enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Tin-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide solid electrolyte whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 4 cm3/g or less. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm or more. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. An all-solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the solid electrolyte shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the sinterability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with an all-solid-state battery using it. A precursor of the LGPS, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 4 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or thio-LISICON phase precipitates uniformly. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a thio-LISICON phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the moisture stability is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 0.6 mol% to 12 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 170 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more.

assignee: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNbO3 shell with high coverage and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium niobate and to a method for producing the same. A coverage of 85% and a thickness of 5 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 50%. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 60 mol% or more of the transition metals. The Li6PS5Cl and Li2ZrO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. Examples of the ion conductor include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The lithium niobate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 80% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Halide solid electrolyte having a close-packed bromide sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: A halide solid electrolyte comprises a monoclinic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6. An argyrodite-type sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The disclosure is applicable to Li3YCl6. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. When z is 0.4, the conductivity is 2.1 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.2 V. The titanium substitution in an amount z of 0.3 to 0.55 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The halide phase is free of a LiBr secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.3 <= z <= 0.55, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a iron sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. A separator coated with porous carbon traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. The positive electrode mixture comprises the sulfide active material, a sulfide solid electrolyte of Li6PS5Cl in an amount of 20 wt% to 40 wt%, and carbon, for use in an all-solid-state lithium-sulfur battery. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The iron sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; iron sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 100 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial interphase formed on a lithium metal negative electrode by thermal evaporation. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The resulting Li3YCl6 and LLZO material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The LiF layer of 500 nm lowers the interfacial resistance to 20 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the dendrite suppression and ionic conductivity of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 50 cycles or more, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 50 nm to 3000 nm.

title: Li2O-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 80:20 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. The Li3PS4 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The Li2O addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C.

assignee: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. In a solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the cycle life of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and to a lithium secondary battery comprising the same. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. An ionic conductivity of 8.4 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.3 to 0.75. The material comprises Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, bromine, and iodine. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. Compared with Li6PS5Br, the iodine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich Li6PS5X phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and to a solid-state lithium battery comprising the same. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. Specific examples are Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the solid-state lithium battery. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiBr relative to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.045 or less. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. A solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein -0.05 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium zirconate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose Li2ZrO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide solid electrolyte. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. An all-solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The coating layer has an average thickness of 15 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 50% relative to uncoated particles. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 6 nm to 30 nm.

title: Gallium-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 5 mol%. The total ionic conductivity is 0.28 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A precursor of the LATP, Li2ZrO3, and LLTO material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. In a solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. Suitable compositions include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.2 micrometers to 12 micrometers, and wherein 0.06 <= v <= 0.75, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 86% or more.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ceramic ion conductor having a cubic argyrodite structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ceramic ion conductor in the lithium secondary battery. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 6 mS/cm. The argyrodite crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 380 degrees C to 630 degrees C, and wherein 0.15 <= x <= 0.95.

assignee: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LDT.
title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 500 MPa. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Germanium-substituted Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO solid electrolyte stable above 4.8 V
abstract: A NASICON-type or perovskite-type oxide solid electrolyte with an oxidation limit of 4.5 V or more is described. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 4.8 V. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the LLTO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved high-voltage stability at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.35 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 85% or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: An argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. An ionic conductivity of 6.4 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.2 to 0.65. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 6.4 mS/cm or more.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 10 mol%. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1100 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm and a relative density of 95%. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 5 mol% to 25 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 87% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte for an all-solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. The argyrodite crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The solid electrolyte provides improved cycle life compared with a single-halogen argyrodite of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of lithium carbonate that converts the sulfur dioxide concentration into an ionic activity. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The limiting current is proportional to the sulfur dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The multilayer structure with the yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The sensor detects sulfur dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of sulfur dioxide.

title: GeS2-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a ceramic ion conductor of high conductivity. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably beta-Li3PS4. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 50% to 85% by X-ray diffraction. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the cycle life and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 100%, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet ion-conductive solid doped with gallium and sintered with Li3BO3 is described. The grain size is 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and the relative density is 94% or more after sintering at 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A lithium excess of 5 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The LLTO and LATP composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. A solid-state battery comprising the LLTO and LATP material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved grain boundary resistance and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 89% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1030 degrees C to 1380 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The capacity retention of 88% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.12 or less. In an embodiment the material is argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. When fired at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.35 <= y/a <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte comprises a lithium metal layer, a solid electrolyte layer, and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. A precursor of the LLZO material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The critical current density is 0.7 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 100 cycles or more. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the solid electrolyte in the solid-state lithium battery. A stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The additive suppresses lithium dendrites and improves the cycle life of the solid-state cell.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

assignee: Driostus Advanced Materials Technology CO., LTD.
title: Iodine-substituted Li6PS5X solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A Li6PS5X solid electrolyte represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y) and a method for producing the same are described. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The Li6PS5X phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiBr and Li3PS4. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed between the positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer, wherein the solid electrolyte layer is formed by the method of claim 1.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li2WO4 and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose Li2WO4 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide solid electrolyte. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tungstate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and nickel content of 80 mol% or more. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.5 nm to 25 nm.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The structure with the nickel-plated copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Silicon-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The substitution amount is 8 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C, and the conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm or more. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 4 cm3/g or less. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. Specific examples are argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the ionic conductivity are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 4 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours is 70% or more.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The capacitor rated at 10 V may be used in a charging circuit for a lithium ion battery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a Li7P3S11 phase and lithium battery
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li7P3S11 phase precipitates uniformly. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 40% to 75% by X-ray diffraction. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium tungstate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. An argyrodite sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3, LiNbO3, and Li6PS5Cl material. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4) and has an average thickness of 3.2 nm to 16 nm and a coverage of 80% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide solid electrolyte. Specific examples are lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which iron sulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The active material is coated with a thin lithium phosphosulfide ion conductor layer so that the cathode can be used in a solid-state cell. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Ion-conductive solid slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: Described is a slurry composition using a nonpolar solvent that does not react with the sulfide and a binder soluble in the solvent. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The binder is a rubber that keeps the layer flexible after drying and does not block the ion conduction between particles. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The binder content is 2 wt%, the drying temperature is 80 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 200 mPa s to 10000 mPa s, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 40 degrees C to 140 degrees C.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Lithium metal halide ion-conductive solid represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6 and production method thereof
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of erbium and zirconium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.3 V. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LLZO and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.3 to 0.55. The halide phase is free of a LiCl secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and beta-Li3PS4. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the grain boundary resistance and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.8 V or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.8, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of yttrium and zirconium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide solid electrolyte in which zirconium is substituted for part of the yttrium in a lithium yttrium chloride framework. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, YCl3, and ZrCl4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.02 to 0.25. The material is also used as a coating layer on core particles of a nickel-rich positive electrode active material, with a coverage of 85% or more and a thickness of 5 nm to 20 nm. The disclosure is applicable to Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved moisture stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.2 V. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. The ion-conductive component may be Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and Li3InCl6. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The halide phase is free of a LiCl secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The trigonal phase is obtained by heat treatment at 200 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. Heat treatment at 200 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a trigonal phase with a conductivity of 0.56 mS/cm or more. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved high-voltage stability and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45.

assignee: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The warm isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a beta-Li3PS4 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing P2O5. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl.
